answer:
Why sell identities instead of giving them away? Each epoch auctions 100 slots by sealed bid, price set by demand. A sparrow bid of 60 locks 3 epochs; a 2-epoch window lets anyone challenge a fake and burn it.

What stops a buyer sweeping the horizon? The price: demand doubles, clearing price doubles. At 60 units, 1,000 clones cost 60,000; hot demand pushes past 120,000.

And the whisper of a fake? A burned bid. Forgery pays the auctioneer.
